channel.description: Computational Thinking Practices Guide CT1 - Design Code CT2 - Develop Code CT3 - Analyze Code CT4 - Document Code and Computing Systems CT5 - Use Computers Responsibly Reference: AP Course and Exam Description CR 1 - Resources Students and teachers have access to a college-level computer science textbook or resource in print or electronic format. Each student has a college-level text for individual use both inside and outside of the classroom, and the teacher has a copy of the most recent edition of a college-level computer science textbook or other appropriate materials to support instruction.
